labelMethod: Source-reviewed by the same development agent; not an independent human-adjudicated or held-out benchmark. Labels authored from pinned app source; no compiler imports or generated output used to generate labels. Prior compiler behavior was known.
unit: One semantic user-triggered business operation. Different route modes create/update and login/register are distinct; reusable components and duplicate template bindings are merged. All listed route variants must match; runtime coverage is operation-level and does not imply all contexts or branches passed.
scope: Writes, explicit queries/retries/pagination, persisted drafts, auth, uploads, and user-followed signed mutation links. Navigation-only and transient presentation/form substeps excluded. Dynamic route and row identifiers are inputs to an agent-facing operation.
schemaScope: Input properties, requiredness, types, enum, bounds and representative valid/invalid payloads; cross-field equality and async/context rules are runtime-only. Target identifiers are required for repeated/dynamic actions. Optional empty password is valid. Draft edits are partial but supplied values describe a persistable valid result. JSON schema correctness is bounded by these checks, not formal equivalence.
